echo_sets.name: Dream of the Lost
echo_sets.note: The game's first 3-piece set; holding 0 Resonance Energy grants 20% Crit Rate and 35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus. Since her max energy is permanently 0, it is always fully active - effectively written for her. Nightmare: Hecate in the main slot adds 12% Havoc DMG and 20% Echo Skill DMG. Pair with a 2-piece Havoc set (Midnight Veil or Havoc Eclipse) for +10% Havoc DMG.

echo_sets.name: Havoc Eclipse
echo_sets.note: Pre-transition option with Nightmare: Crownless as main echo; replace with the 3-piece Dream of the Lost + 2-piece Havoc setup once farmed.

build.energy_regen_target: Not needed - Phrolova has 0 max Resonance Energy, so Energy Regen provides zero value.
build.fast_path: Phrolova is a 5-star Havoc Rectifier hypercarry whose puppet Hecate deals off-field Echo Skill DMG; her max Resonance Energy is permanently 0, so the unique 3-piece Dream of the Lost set (20% Crit Rate, 35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus) is always fully active with Nightmare: Hecate as main echo, paired with a 2-piece Havoc set. Her signature Lethean Elegy is strongly recommended, roughly a 17% gap over Stringmaster. Run Crit DMG on Cost 4, Havoc DMG on both Cost 3, ATK% on both Cost 1; Energy Regen is useless since she cannot hold Resonance Energy.

ranked_weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
ranked_weapons.note: Signature Rectifier (587 ATK, 24.3% Crit Rate). After dealing Echo Skill DMG: +32% Resonance Skill DMG, +32% Echo Skill DMG Amplification, 8% DEF ignore - covers both of her damage types. Relative damage ~100% vs 82.9% for Stringmaster; she is the team's main damage dealer, so the standing recommendation is to get her signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: Best fallback at ~82.9% relative damage (up to ~86% if you trim 10% Crit Rate from the build for its Crit Rate main stat). Gives Crit Rate, ATK, and 12% Havoc DMG Bonus, but ATK is devalued during Maestro since she already gains +120% ATK there.

ranked_weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
ranked_weapons.note: ~82.7% relative damage. ATK and Crit DMG are useful, but its Basic Attack passive is mostly wasted (Basic Attacks are ~5% of her damage) and its effect ends early on swap.

ranked_weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
ranked_weapons.note: ~77% relative damage. Usable ATK and high Crit DMG, but the Basic Attack-focused passive gives her little.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Free-to-play standard-banner option for a placeholder build; pair with Crownless echoes until the Dream of the Lost transition.

stat_priorities.note: Signature provides 24.3% Crit Rate; use a Crit Rate 4-cost when on a Crit DMG weapon or if the build is under-crit. Build target: Crit Rate 74-78%, Crit DMG 270-275%.
Double Havoc beats ATK/Havoc (100% vs ~96.9% relative). Only run ATK%/Havoc if the substats are much better. Build target: ATK 2150-2250 with Havoc/Havoc (2400-2560 with ATK/Havoc).

profile.role_note: On-field summoner of Hecate; her liberation commands Hecate to fight for 24s, dealing off-field Echo Skill DMG even while Phrolova is swapped out. Her Outro grants the incoming Resonator 20% Havoc DMG and 25% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Phrolova remains a top-tier Havoc hypercarry in October 2026 tier lists (SS on Beebom's Version 3.7 list), and her signature weapon carries a real ~17% damage gap over Stringmaster, so budget for both on her next rerun. Her most recent documented rerun was Version 2.8, so expect a longer wait. Pull if you need a Havoc main DPS or already own Cantarella or Qiuyuan; skip if your Havoc or off-field damage slot is already filled.

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: Hypercarry; summons Hecate in Maestro, which keeps dealing off-field Echo Skill DMG for up to 24s.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Havoc Bane support for Negative Status teams; her Havoc buffs slot into Phrolova teams per community guides.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Universal Crit buffer with a huge field-wide healing package for survivability-first clears.

teams.name: Premium: Phrolova + Chisa + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Start with Phrolova: chain Basic Attack Stage 3 and Resonance Skill to build 6 Volatile Notes, then cast Scarlet Coda and Resonance Liberation to enter Maestro. Swap to Shorekeeper for Liberation and the Crit field, then Chisa for Havoc Bane stacks; Chisa's Echo Skills feed Hecate's enhanced attacks off-field (up to 10 triggers per Maestro). Shorekeeper's Outro returns to a fully buffed Phrolova for the next loop.

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: Still the damage core; off-field Hecate means she does not need much field time.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Free 4-star quick-swap sub-DPS; generates Concerto fast with minimal field time.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free universal healer and buffer; her Outro deepens the whole team's damage.

teams.name: Budget: Phrolova + Sanhua + Verina
teams.rotation: Sanhua quick-swaps to fill Concerto and hand buffs over, then Verina for Liberation and Outro. Phrolova enters on Intro, builds 6 Volatile Notes, casts Scarlet Coda into Liberation (Maestro), and swaps out; teammates' Echo Skills keep triggering Hecate's enhanced attacks while Verina sustains the team.

teams_meta.note: Sources document Cantarella and Roccia as her staple partners, but both are outside the portrait roster, so the comps above substitute roster members in equivalent support roles (Chisa's Havoc buffs are noted as slotting in by the gurugamer 2.8 rerun guide).

tier_badge.label: Top tier DPS
tier_badge.note: Most October 2026 lists keep her at the top (SS on Beebom 3.7, SS on PocketTactics, S on MMO Culture 3.6), but GachaGo's October 2026 update demoted her to A.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete kit. Aim S2 for the Coda spike, stop at S3 for value, S6 only for whales.
